'''François Georges René Bruhat''' ({{IPA|fr|bʁy.a|lang}}; 8 April 1929 – 17 July 2007) was a French [[mathematician]] who worked on [[algebraic groups]].   The [[Bruhat order]] of a [[Weyl group]], the [[Bruhat decomposition]], and the [[Schwartz&ndash;Bruhat function]]s are named after him.

He was the son of [[physicist]] (and associate director of the [[École Normale Supérieure]] during the [[German occupation of France during World War II|occupation]]) [[Georges Bruhat]], and brother of physicist [[Yvonne Choquet-Bruhat]].
